skill1: the Full Burst Pierce Damage ▲13.55% targets alliesOfWeapon SR — the kit grants it only to Sniper-Rifle-wielding allies. d-killer-wife is herself SR, so she keeps it.

skill1: the self 'Gain Pierce for 1 shot' (every 3 full charges) is a ROUND-COUNT budget — hitCount 3 → gainPierce durationShots 1, so one shot in three carries the Pierce tag (the granting round never spends the budget, and a budget survives reloads and lulls where a durationSec stand-in would drain). Kit-literal: both numbers are read verbatim from the clause, and hitCount matches the encoding this file already uses for the identical 'Full Charge for N time(s)' shape on S2. The tag adds no TARGETS on the partless boss — what it does is make that shot read the Damage-Up bucket's Pierce Damage ▲ entries, which DO apply on a partless boss (docs/data/game-mechanics.md §11; the multi-part-only mechanic is the core+body double-hit, a different thing). Its worth is therefore comp-dependent, not a fixed per-unit number: +2.4–2.6% where her own FB-window 13.55% is the only pierce source, and +20.0% in the N1 comp, where grave's permanent all-ally pierceDamagePct 48.4 is live the whole fight.

BLOCK ORDER IS LOAD-BEARING: the status-inflicting block precedes the gated block in the burst array and both fire on the same burstCast frame, so the gate reads a status written earlier that same frame — do not reorder. The block carries NO requiresCore, deliberately: 'Allies that hit the BODY' means non-core on the partless boss, so the branch must be LIVE whenever Wipe Out is up (maximally so at coreHitRate 0, where every hit is a body hit). The requiresCore proxy belongs only on the parked parts branch below.
